notes:
"Underwater basket weaving" is a well-known idiom for an impractical/joke class, not a real activity — and nothing in the search turned up an actual toddler program by that name anywhere, let alone in Halton Hills. The closest real things found were adult basketry workshops elsewhere and Halton Hills' own children's programs page, which lists toddler dance, skateboarding, etc., but no basket weaving of any kind for that age group.
